archetype: ARCHETYPE 7: ELECTRIC & NEON (Tactical Degen Meta Command Center)
theme: Dark Mode (Obsidian Black, Deep Charcoal, Tactical Slate with Electric Mint Neon Accents)

headings.hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white

data_values.contract_address: font-mono text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-900/60 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-slate-800

layout_architecture.grid_system: MODE B: High Density Command Center Grid (Meta for Degens)

nav_header.style: Sticky Crystal Glass Navy Bar with Backdrop Blur
nav_header.content: Feeless Green Logo + Live Ticker Marquee + Chain Selector + Quick Search Contract + Wallet Modal Trigger + Whitepaper Modal Button
nav_header.classes: h-16 border-b border-slate-800/80 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-xl z-50 px-4 flex items-center justify-between

main_content_zones.zone_1_globe_header: Interactive 3D Globe with Launchpad Node overlays (Pump.fun, Raydium, Moonshot, Uniswap, Four.meme) with live pulse animations.
main_content_zones.zone_2_token_discovery: Real public market token feed (DexScreener API integration) filtered by Launchpad (Pump.fun, Moonshot, Raydium, All), search input, sorting by volume/24h change/liquidity.
main_content_zones.zone_3_dexscreener_chart: Selected Token Chart View using official DexScreener embed iframe (`https://dexscreener.com/{pair_id}?embed=1&theme=dark`), token stats bar, fast liquidity/market cap metric cards, and watchlist toggle.
main_content_zones.zone_4_degen_chat: Persistent Polling Chat Widget with channels (`#general`, `#alpha`, `#pump-fun`, `#memes`), user handle system, emoji reaction bar, and mint green message indicators.
main_content_zones.zone_5_launchpad_directory: Directory of Launchpads (Pump.fun, Moonshot, Raydium, Apex, Four.meme) with direct links, status badges, volume stats, and node highlighting on 3D globe.
main_content_zones.zone_6_whitepaper_modal: Full-screen or reader dialog showcasing the Feeless Zero-Tax Zero-Fee Ecosystem Blueprint, Tokenomics, and Degen Meta Roadmap.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800/90 shadow-2xl shadow-black/50
visual_enhancers.ticker_marquee: Fast moving or gentle stream live token updates bar using react-fast-marquee with mint green positive indicators.

interactive_components.token_card: High density token row/card with launchpad badge (Pump.fun mint green, Moonshot purple, Raydium blue), token symbol, price in USD, 5m/1h/24h % change, market cap, liquidity, copy CA button, and click to view chart.
interactive_components.launchpad_pill: Rounded-full tag with brand color, active glow state, and filtered feed trigger.
interactive_components.contract_search: Input box with instant paste detection, validation for Solana/EVM addresses, and DexScreener lookup.
interactive_components.whitepaper_dialog: Shadcn Dialog styled like an encrypted tactical dossier with table of contents, zero-fee tokenomics visualizer, and download PDF button.
interactive_components.chat_panel: Tabbed chat window with auto-scroll down, instant mock message dispatch, polling updates, and online degen counter.

testing_and_data_ids.rule: Every interactive and critical visual node MUST have a descriptive kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the supplied logo URL (https://customer-assets-jt897jd0.emergentagent.net/job_24652869-54a6-42fd-b217-760374ca0c8b/artifacts/z95slnsw_fee%20no%20bg.png) is rendered prominently in the header and landing header.
Maintain the existing 3D Globe functionality while integrating interactive Launchpad node overlays for Pump.fun, Raydium, Uniswap, Moonshot, and Four.meme.
Ensure DexScreener API integration retrieves live public Solana / EVM token pools with real charts via iframe embeds.
Use JetBrains Mono / monospace formatting for numbers, contract addresses, and market caps.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for automated test validation.
Keep styling in standard React JSX with Tailwind CSS classes. Do NOT use TypeScript .tsx files.
